execution: Native stock inputs; candidate uses real-time JKCP, loopback Hub, deployed Supervisor and isolated policy worker.

qualification.reason: The deployed candidate arm escaped fewer assigned starts than baseline; no trial qualified for autonomous candidate credit.
qualification.autonomous_candidate_rate_reason: Zero attribution-eligible independent candidate trials; baseline controls interleaved in all wet takeovers.

post_matrix_change.change: Require positive goal distance before recording a local displacement win. This affects a custom policy moving from an already-reached endpoint; shipped policy waits there. No control dispatch, bank outcome, model inference or physics changes.
post_matrix_change.evidence: Dedicated regression failed before the guard and is included in the final passing suite. All 688 recorded candidate motor attempt goals were strictly positive, so the added branch does not alter any recorded attempt classification.

baseline_compatibility.comparison: Native baseline observation and landing compatibility

physical_reference.criterion: Capability disabled. Equal supported dry time at original millisecond precision, landing health and sector.

baseline_compatibility.manifest_method: SHA-256 of sorted episode filenames as [{episode,sha256}] with .jsonl removed and compact sorted-key JSON.

prior_full_matrix.note: Retained pre-review-fix run. New qualification uses the complete second matrix above; the earlier run is not substituted or selected for its better result.

paired_survivor_statistics.scope: Both arms landed. Excludes the five candidate failures; cannot summarize all assigned-start performance.

limitations: One-map simplified actor fixture with nine captured poses and 27 case/yaw combinations, not 27 independent map situations.
Real stock movement/collision/endurance and ordinary inputs, but no opponents, rendering, item grants or stock Force scripts.
Initial horizontal velocity is zero; existing air-recovery timer is primed.
The default learned motor chunk is 550 ms; demonstrations used 26–87 ms control intervals. This is a mismatch to investigate, not an established cause of failure.
Python/controller startup and command arrival use real wall time. Repeated coupled runs can differ; small timing differences are not evidence of learned superiority.
Assigned physical outcomes and controller attribution remain separate. Assisted landings and no-takeover landings do not certify autonomous neural skill.
Live sampled stopping records stay censored even if an independently identified native replay lands.
Raw retail geometry, credentials, gameplay databases, signed media URLs and third-party clips are excluded.
